event_description: Declares a disaster emergency in Nassau and Suffolk counties due to a severe snowstorm with high winds beginning January 20, 2000, during a job action by Department of Transportation snowplow operators.
Declares a disaster in Erie County, including the City of Buffalo, and contiguous counties due to severe snowstorms with blizzard-like conditions beginning November 20, 2000.

Declares a disaster in the City of New York and Nassau, Suffolk, Westchester, Rockland, Orange, Putnam, Sullivan, Delaware, Dutchess, Columbia, Greene, Ulster, Schenectady and Albany counties due to severe snowstorms with high winds and blizzard conditions beginning February 16, 2003.

Declares a disaster in Cayuga, Chenango, Livingston, Madison, Monroe, Oneida, Onondaga, Ontario, Orleans, Oswego, Seneca, Wayne and Yates counties due to severe storms with severe icing beginning April 3, 2003.

Declares a disaster in Broome, Chenango, Cortland, Delaware, Greene, Montgomery, Orange, Otsego, Rensselaer, Schenectady, Schoharie, Sullivan, Tioga and Ulster counties due to an April storm with heavy rains and flooding beginning April 2, 2005.

Declares a disaster in Erie, Essex, Warren, Wyoming and contiguous counties due to a storm system with heavy rains, severe thunderstorms, damaging winds and hail causing flooding beginning June 6, 2005.

Declares a disaster in Broome, Delaware, Herkimer, Montgomery, Otsego, Cortland, Chenango, Schoharie and Tioga counties due to a severe storm causing torrential rains and flooding beginning June 27, 2006.
Declares a disaster in Erie, Genesee, Niagara and Orleans counties and contiguous areas due to severe storms with heavy snow beginning October 12, 2006.

Declares a disaster within the territorial boundaries of the State of New York due to hazardous winter weather from a Nor'easter, with forecast snowfall of 12 to 24 inches, potential blizzard conditions and high winds beginning on or about March 14, 2017.

Declares a disaster emergency in Cayuga, Jefferson, Monroe, Niagara, Orleans, Oswego, Saint Lawrence and Wayne counties due to high water levels in Lake Ontario and the Saint Lawrence River causing coastal flooding and erosion.

Declares a disaster in Broome, Chemung, Chenango, Cortland, Delaware, Monroe, Onondaga, Ontario, Schuyler, Seneca, Steuben, Tioga, Wayne, Yates and contiguous counties due to severe storms producing heavy rainfall and flooding beginning August 14, 2018.

Declares a disaster in Cayuga, Chautauqua, Cortland, Dutchess, Erie, Essex, Hamilton, Herkimer, Montgomery, Oneida, Saratoga, Warren and contiguous counties due to severe weather with damaging winds and torrential rain beginning October 31, 2019.

Declares a disaster in Bronx, Dutchess, Kings, Nassau, New York, Orange, Putnam, Queens, Richmond, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester and contiguous counties due to Tropical Storm Isaias beginning August 4, 2020.
